description: Fixed determinism edit sequence for the index-maintainer harness. Each step is replayed as ONE reconciler tick. Paths are relative to the project root (the materialized copy of fixtures/mini-repo).

steps.name: add
steps.comment: Add a brand-new file with no prior index state.

steps.name: modify-1-chunk
steps.comment: Change a single function body in beta.js; the other chunk is hash-reused.

steps.name: modify-with-dependency-change
steps.comment: Rename a symbol in util.js. alpha.js imports it, so the dependent file must re-embed (enrichment input changed) even though alpha's own text is touched here too to make the dependency edge explicit.

steps.name: delete
steps.comment: Delete beta.js; all tiers must tombstone and the merkle entry drops.

steps.name: rename
steps.comment: Rename alpha.js -> alphaRenamed.js. The reconciler sees old path deleted and new path added.
